admission.justification: A stale setter interface can make return fail after the subject changes, losing the captured reading position.

applicability: Return from a followed intent marker in the existing review workspace.
conditions: The captured subject is restored before the worklist boolean, opened path, layout and full-file choice.
The production workspace state exposes setWorklist; a recording test stand-in must match that interface.
exclusions: Comparison-viewer Back/Escape, which is a separate return path.
A claim that this leaf repaired a user-facing marker-store failure; the delivered real-store witness found none.

evidence: markerNavigation.test.ts 5/5 green; temporary real-store probe (useWorkspaceState capture/restore) 1/1, then removed (s3-triage.log)

statement: The marker return restores subject, worklist view, opened file, layout and full-file choice through the real workspace store.
